The Assistant Director for Educational Talent Search provides comprehensive academic, college, and career readiness services to program participants and works closely with school sites, families, and community partners to advance program objectives. This position provides leadership in establishing and maintaining collaborative relationships between UC Davis, local schools, and community-based organizations, and represents the program and UC Davis at schools, conferences, committees, and meetings. The Assistant Director is responsible for student outreach, cohort case management, and the development and implementation of strategic recruitment initiatives to attract eligible students at select Shasta County schools.
30% - Program Development and Management

Administrative and supervisory duties include onboarding and training new and ongoing staff, managing the secure maintenance and auditing of confidential student files to ensure compliance, and assisting with the creation of program publications, forms, and grant proposals. On-site delivery of services includes developing academic preparation activities, tutoring resources, career exploration, and the program's core curriculum. Additionally, the Assistant Director presents information on general college readiness, organizes campus visits, and delivers both group and individual academic advising, workshops, field trips, and events tailored to participants at target schools.
50% - Academic Support Services
NOTE: This is an in-person role in Shasta County. The Assistant Director must reside in the local area to support daily, on-site student engagement at select schools.
10% - Admissions, Outreach, and Public Relations
